gloss: beginning of spring; first day of spring

definitions.gloss: beginning of spring; first day of spring (in the traditional calendar)
definitions.explanation: One of the 24 solar terms in the traditional East Asian calendar, marking the start of spring. Falls around February 3-5 in the modern calendar. Despite the name, it is still cold in most of Japan at this time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{立春|りっしゅん}です。
examples.english: Today is the first day of spring.

examples.japanese: {立春|りっしゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎて→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{寒|さむ}い→寒い：00664_samui⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Cold days continue even after the start of spring.

examples.japanese: ⟦{暦|こよみ}→暦：19338_koyomi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{立春|りっしゅん}だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦まだまだ→まだまだ：10505_madamada⟧⟦{冬|ふゆ}→冬：00623_fuyu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: On the calendar it's the start of spring, but the winter cold still lingers.

notes:
Composed of {立|りつ} (stand/establish) and {春|しゅん} (spring). One of the ⟦{二十四節気|にじゅうしせっき}→二十四節気：25146_nijuushisekki⟧ (24 solar terms), an ancient system dividing the year based on the sun's position. {立春|りっしゅん} typically falls around February 4th.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {立春|りっしゅん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to welcome the start of spring
- {立春|りっしゅん}⟦{大吉|だいきち}→大吉：19336_daikichi⟧: great luck on the first day of spring (auspicious phrase)
- ⟦{暦|こよみ}→暦：19338_koyomi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{立春|りっしゅん}: on the calendar it's spring

CULTURAL NOTE:
The day before {立春|りっしゅん} is ⟦{節分|せつぶん}→節分：18971_setsubun⟧, when people throw beans (⟦{豆|まめ}まき→豆まき：14275_mamemaki⟧) to drive away evil spirits. Letters written after {立春|りっしゅん} conventionally use spring greetings even if the weather is still cold.

RELATED WORDS:

- ⟦{立秋|りっしゅう}→立秋：26285_risshuu⟧: beginning of autumn
- ⟦{立冬|りっとう}→立冬：26312_rittou⟧: beginning of winter
- ⟦{節分|せつぶん}→節分：18971_setsubun⟧: the day before {立春|りっしゅん}, bean-throwing festival
